item.title: 【BLU-RAY】BLU-RAY - Depeche Mode - M (2025) Blu-ray
item.description:
Depeche Mode - M (2025) Blu-ray



The Depeche Mode: M Blu-ray bundle includes two Blu-rays and two CDs, containing the new feature film Depeche Mode: M, as well as the video and audio releases of Memento Mori: Mexico City, which chronicle the band’s three sold out 2023 concerts at Mexico City’s legendary Foro Sol Stadium during the Memento Mori World Tour. Also included in the package is a booklet featuring live photos from the Mexico City shows.
M is by Mexican filmmaker Fernando Frías and is described as a cinematic journey into the heart of Mexican cultures relationship with death, framed by riveting live performances from Depeche Mode during their Memento Mori tour. The film blends concert footage with interpretive interstitials and archive material. This film is also getting a limited theatrical release.

item.description:
Frankie Goes To Hollywood - Welcome To The Pleasure Dome (SDE Exclusive Deluxe Edition) (2025) Blu-Ray Audio



Frankie Goes To Hollywood's 1984 double album 'Welcome to the Pleasuredome' features three UK No 1s, 'Relax', 'Two Tribes' and 'The Power of Love', along with the 12 minute album version of the title track. Mixed in Dolby Atmos, 5.1 and stereo by Steven Wilson the blu-ray also includes unique instrumentals of the full album in Atmos, 5.1 and Stereo and the original 1984 stereo mix. It's topped off with six bonus tracks in Dolby Atmos, 5.1 and Stereo plus an exclusive 30 minute 'Supanova' mix of 'Welcome to the Pleasuredome'. Comes in a reversible sleeve which features the UK casette cover on the reverse, a standard slipcase and a bonus black & gold foil-blocked slipcase.
